zh.name: 数码开箱与配件平铺
zh.summary: 按拆盒顺序展示数码产品和随机配件。
zh.useWhen: 适合新款数码产品和配件较多的套装。
zh.instructions: 上传包装照、开箱照和配件平铺图，填写卖点。
zh.output: 数码开箱图和配件清单。

en.name: Electronics Unboxing and Accessory Layout
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about electronics Unboxing and Accessory Layout.
en.useWhen: For electronics launches and bundles with several accessories.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with electronics Unboxing and Accessory Layout.
